title: Learning Team Session: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: A learning-team facilitator and the people who do the work: fitters, operators and a stores clerk
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: The spares record and the field accounts describe the seal work differently; the session asks the team how the job is really done.
Start with return to service: the team knows what the missing checklist meant on shift.

items.text: The team supplies the answers. These are questions, not findings about people.

sections.heading: Work as imagined and work as done

lint_ok.reason: HFACS code names are taxonomy headings, not statements about people.

items.question: What made sense at the time about restarting the pump after the seal change?
items.why: The export records the restart; the team knows what the shift needed then.

items.question: What made sense at the time about returning the pump to service with no checklist to hand?
items.why: No return-to-service checklist existed; the team knows what took its place.

items.question: What made sense at the time about buying seals locally when the specified ones were not in stores?
items.why: The spares record shows local purchases; the team knows how the choice was made.

items.question: What made sense at the time about how the gas alarm was answered with no automatic shutdown?
items.why: The alarm had no trip; the team knows the usual first response.

rows: Welcome, the ground rules and the banner read aloud
Set a learning frame: no blame, no judgement of people
Walk through the job as it is normally done
Hear work as done before comparing it with the procedure
Work through the questions, one at a time
Soak: a short break, then what surprised you
Let the first answers settle before fixes
What would make the job easier to do safely
Gather the team's ideas; no decisions on people

items.text: The workers are the experts on the work: ask, listen and write down their words, not your summary.
Learn first and fix later: keep the first meeting for discovery and hold fixes for a second meeting after a soak.
Ask how the work normally goes, not only about the day of the event.
The team records its answers, in its own words, in learning-team-notes.csv; the facilitator never fills in the answer column for them.
